text:
yvonne: Morning — ingest ops observed a spike of late events (EU) between 00:30-02:00 UTC. Recompute queue length doubled and we're seeing 95th token latency creep on shared pools. Can we add a short admission-control policy so background rehydrates don't starve live traffic? cc @sam @oscar

sam: Proposal: admission control with two quick checks before enqueue: 1) regional_token_budget (e.g. max_concurrent_tokens_background=5_000_000), 2) batch-aware admission: if incoming_job.tokens + current_background_tokens > budget reject or downgrade to passive queue. Also allow `precheck.dedupe=true` to skip obvious duplicates.

yvonne: Sounds good. How would callers opt-in? We don't want to change default behavior for customers mid-night.

sam: Default remains unchanged. New parameter in internal API: `admission_hint=background_ok` or `admission_hint=passive_only`. Example curl for opt-in tenants:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api/replays 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -d '{"tenant":"acme","window":"2h","admission_hint":"background_ok","precheck.dedupe":true}'
```
Scheduler returns acceptance or suggested downgrade in the response.

oscar: Console UX: show a small pill after submit if scheduler suggests downgrade: "Scheduled as passive (to protect live API)." Also display cost + wait estimate if background assigned. We can get cost_estimate from scheduler: `tokens, est_cost, est_wait_ms`.

ops: Telemetry/billing asks: add `replay.routing.admission` tag (values: background, passive, downgraded) and `replay.precheck.dedupe_rate`. Also ensure billing unit counts are unchanged when jobs move lanes. For canary, request a short quota for dedicated-eu background slots. Use rb-tool.

telemetry-bot: Canary job started rp-20260315-canary (tenant=acme) status=queued precheck.dedupe=true estimated_tokens=900000

sam: Safety rule: if api_p95 > 2x baseline OR shared_pool_queue_depth > 4k then auto-downgrade new background admissions to passive and return a `suggested_action=downgrade` field in create response. Also log `admission.reason` for audit.

yvonne: I'll own the scheduler PR and feature flag. Oscar, can you add the pill and the tooltip copy? Ops, please file the quota request link. Plan: ff in staging, 1-tenant 3h canary, monitor p95 + dedupe_rate + token burn, then decide.

oscar: Will add the UI text and show cost estimate. Tooltip copy draft: "Background rehydrates use regional reserved capacity when available; may reduce wait times but incur reserved-slot usage. Click to request quota."

ops: Quota ticket created with rb-tool: `rb-tool quota request --tenant acme --pool dedicated-eu --tokens 1000000 --hours 3` (ticket# 9123). Monitoring team alerted.

yvonne: Thanks. We'll run canary at 01:00 UTC and post results here. If we see regressions revert ff. :thumbsup:
